body:
## Problem
Services communicate via shared filesystem (JSON files) and direct WebSocket connections. This tightly couples services and prevents independent scaling.

## Requirements
- Integrate message queue (RabbitMQ or NATS)
- Define event schemas for all inter-service communication
- Migrate from polling to event-driven updates
- Implement dead letter queues for failed events

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Message queue integrated
- [ ] All inter-service events go through message bus
- [ ] Event schemas versioned and documented
- [ ] Dead letter handling with alerting
title: Implement event-driven architecture with message queue (RabbitMQ/NATS) for service communication
